scope: Four inactive proofs reconstruct smooth proper Hessian existence, uniform smooth admissible approximation of continuous potentials, sharp uniform stability of proper solutions, and smoothness of continuous admissible weak solutions for 2<=m<n on a strictly positive Hermitian background. A penalty construction uses only a smooth Newton-form linear maximum principle; positive exponential coefficient a is reduced to coefficient one by scaling the metric and potential. The continuous viscosity version of TWWY Theorem 3.4 applies directly to the reconstructed limit, avoiding a second auxiliary family. Continuous Hessian products and strict domination remain explicitly declared primary inputs; general bounded-solution continuity is not asserted.
